chapter: Piron, Pichon and the boat bands
title: Boat-band drummers and bassists from St. Louis
summary: Williams recalls the Dile family bassists and drummers who played with Fate Marable, Dewey Jackson and Joe Robichaud.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Yes, around St. Louis. Did you ever know Harry Dile, the drummer?
I just wondered if there were any Kim, because Harry I know used to play on the boats. Where was he from? I think he was from around St. Louis, but he played on the boats too.
Yeah, Harry Diles. He played with Fate? I believe. Or Dewey Jackson.
I forget, I can't remember all that.
Dewey Jackson had this boy, Floyd Campbell, playing with him. Yeah. And Fate had this boy named Toro, nice looking boy. I forget his name. And I believe Little Bucket played with Fate, didn't he?
He come here with Fate, I think. I think he did. He got the drum, Fate, at the 5, and he played with Joe Robichaud. Nice little drummer. Bucket. Okay, I agree. He wasn't from here though.
No, no. I've heard about him. Yeah, nice drummer.
Played with Joe a long time.
Joe had a nice band, Joe Robichaud.
